notes: Field lexical collection preserved in Bhasha Sanchika audio and manuscript archive. Metadata catalogued; audio access restricted.
background: Recorded in 1982 by field linguist Dr. S. Arokianathan during dialect mapping surveys across the Ukhrul district. Preserved in the CIIL Bhasha Sanchika audio and manuscript archive. Documents ethnographic material culture, pottery techniques, weaving terminology, and village-level lexical variations.
phonology_notes: Phonetic transcriptions cross-referenced with tape recordings. Includes specific material culture terminology for Longpi black pottery, traditional salt manufacturing, and weaving.

entries.example: Hamlei khami (Shaping the black stone pot).

definitions_en: crushed serpentinite rock used in wheel-less pottery
entries.example: Leshong lung kaphei (Crushing the serpentinite rock).

definitions_en: sacred forked sacrificial post erected during feast of merit
entries.example: Tarang kaphungli rui (Decorating the sacred forked post).

definitions_en: prestigious embroidered wrap for Tangkhul women
entries.example: Chonkhom kachon kakhon (Draping the prestigious Chonkhom wrap).

definitions_en: handwoven skirt with colored geometric panels
entries.example: Seichan kashan kakhon (Wearing the traditional handwoven skirt).
